title: 消费放缓担忧下：Uber订单却增22%，巴西竞争压力会否拖累增长？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The gross bookings outlook, like there's a number of stories within it, I'd also note like at the same time, ride your activity seems to be increasing. You know, help us understand
segments.zh: 总预订量展望中，包含多个因素。同时，出行活动似乎也在增加。请帮助我们理解这两个数据点。

segments.en: those two data points. Yeah, the gross bookings results that we have up 22% in the quarter were
segments.zh: 本季度总预订量同比增长22%，实际上非常健康，且环比加速。

segments.en: actually very healthy and represented quarter on quarter acceleration. Mobility business was stable of 20%, the delivery business actually accelerated quarter on quarter as well. So the
segments.zh: 出行业务稳定增长20%，配送业务也环比加速。业务在如此规模下仍以惊人速度增长。

segments.en: business continues to grow at pretty extraordinary rates at the scale. We're doing over 300 million
segments.zh: 我们每周完成超过3亿次行程，这也带来了强劲的盈利能力。

segments.en: trips per week. It drove really strong profitability as well. The pressure that we talked about was
segments.zh: 我们提到的压力主要来自巴西，导致本季度出行放缓。

segments.en: really in Brazil, which caused a trip slowdown for the quarter. And that was actually about
segments.zh: 这实际上与食品配送领域的竞争有关。在巴西，我们有很多两轮车出行用户，但我们并不参与食品配送。

segments.en: competition in the food delivery space. In Brazil, actually, we have a lot of mobility ridership that are two wheelers. We actually don't engage in the food delivery space, but there's a big war
segments.zh: 然而，食品配送领域正进行激烈竞争，这吸引了一些两轮车司机从出行转向配送，因为他们参与竞争可获得高额报酬。

segments.en: going on in food delivery and that took away some of our two wheeler drivers from mobility to delivery because they're getting paid a lot to engage in that war. It really has no effect on us whatsoever.
segments.zh: 这实际上对我们没有影响。
